conditions: f defined on an open interval containing x; finite two-sided limit exists.

evidence: This is the definition of a finite ordinary two-sided derivative: the limit of the slopes between (x,f(x)) and (x+h,f(x+h)) as nonzero h tends to zero. The open interval and finite-limit conditions ensure that this definition applies.
